heading: Salaries of Representatives, Delegates, and Resident Commissioners elected for unexpired terms
lead: The salaries of Representatives in Congress, Delegates from Territories, and Resident Commissioners, elected for unexpired terms, shall commence on the date of their election and not before.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 37 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
